item.title: Every Celebrity Look At The British Vogue X British GQ Fashion & Film Party
item.description: See the stars at Vogue and GQ's 2026 Fashion & Film party, featuring BAFTA winners and nominees. In what has become a BAFTA night tradition, once the trophies were all dished out and the speeches wrapped, the stars decamped to the Fashion & Film party, held for the first time at the newly reopened Simpson’s in the Strand.
